SEARCH: // prevents double relevance, the keywords themselves provide
// relevance, the mode doesn\'t need to double it
REPLACE: // Add support for Ruby character literals
{ regex: /\\C-([a-zA-Z])/, replacement: (match, char) => String.fromCharCode(char.charCodeAt(0) - 64) }, // Control characters
{ regex: /\\M-([a-zA-Z])/, replacement: (match, char) => String.fromCharCode(char.charCodeAt(0) + 128) } // Meta characters
